Lighting in Norwich and Norfolk

We fit indoor and outdoor lighting across Norwich and Norfolk, from LED strips and downlights to pendants and outside wall lights. Replacing a light fitting takes about an hour and costs £80 plus VAT.

Call 07576 485671 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

We only use recognised brands such as Scolmore, Crabtree and JCC, with attention to detail throughout.

Kitchens: LED Strips and Pendants

In our kitchen photos, LED strips run under the wall cabinets to light the worktop, and glass pendants hang over a table and a worktop.

Living Rooms: Downlights and LED Coves

In the living rooms, recessed downlights light the room and a warm LED cove runs along the top of a feature wall.

Outside: Wall Lights and Soffit Downlights

Outside, wall lights light up a brick cottage after dark, and downlights in the soffit over a garage door light the drive.

Photos From Our Lighting Jobs

A Lighting Circuit That Kept Tripping

How Long It Takes and What It Costs

  • Replacement light fitting: about 1 hour, £80 plus VAT, whether the old one has failed or you just want an upgrade

Questions We Get Asked

My lights keep tripping, can you help?

Yes. On one recent job a lighting circuit kept tripping and wouldn't come back on. The fault was water getting into an outside junction box, and it took 2 hours in total to find and repair.
